outing.hero_prompt_english: China Printing Museum in Daxing: a coherent museum interior with a large historical cast-iron printing press, trays of abstract blank movable-type blocks and a roller mechanism, warm paper sheets and an adult visitor examining the machine from behind a museum boundary. Architectural perspective and machinery form an isometric educational scene, no reproduction of copyrighted prints or legible typesetting. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
